properties.title: 1493: Uncovering the New World Columbus Created

properties.description: A deeply researched work of history and science journalism that explores the global effects of the Columbian Exchange—the worldwide transfer of plants, animals, diseases, and people—following Christopher Columbus's voyage. The book argues that this ecological collision ushered in a new biological and economic era, fostering the rise of Europe, impacting China, and fundamentally shaping the modern globalized world, a period Mann calls the 'Homogenocene'. It is the companion book to his bestseller *1491*.
